_about: THE PHONE SHOWS TWO JOBS (UI [the phone shows two jobs], rule 148, Paolo 10/24: 'the phone really should only be displaying the top two jobs, the two highest paying jobs in the whole Bohemia city, and it doesn't need to display so much information, it's overkill with the amount of text you put on the phone'). Each job on the phone's face is one short what (here, at most 20 letters so it never wraps on the 156-point phone), its stars, its pay and its place; the full title (the shelf's own words) shows only once it is tapped. Keyed by the job's id from records/target/BOHEMIA_BOARD_SHELF.json and the settlement's own OFFERS. A job with no line here shows its own title cut to the glass. Words are attempts: draft:true (rule 8/11). A modder edits this file, nothing else.
